answer: Reputation decays about 8% per idle epoch, and each identity may bank one graded claim per epoch. Every claim gets re-checked by an agent with no shared funding and no shared proxy, so a quartz cluster cannot vouch for itself. A farm of 500 shells must keep 500 pipes warm every epoch or watch its marble score slide below payout. The canyon between upkeep and honest work is the defense, and the upkeep bill arrives whether or not the work does.
